facts.text: Omni La Costa Resort & Spa is a 400-acre Spanish Mission-style property north of San Diego.
facts.excerpt: Tucked inside a Spanish Mission-style property north of San Diego, 400-acre Omni La Costa Resort & Spa

facts.text: The resort is in Carlsbad, California, at 2100 Costa Del Mar Road.

contradictions.note: p2 (official) states a $55 daily resort charge; p3 (Conde Nast Traveler) states a $45 resort fee

sources.excerpt: A daily resort charge of $55 is added to the daily room rate
A $45 resort fee covers Wi-Fi, gym access, local calls, in-room coffee and tea, and a daily newspaper (upon request).
